text:
NimbusLoop is a fast-growing Chennai startup building realtime analytics for e-commerce merchants. We turn messy event streams into actionable insights with a lightweight, low-latency platform that scales. We move fast, value pragmatic engineering, and ship code that matters to customers.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain backend services using Python and FastAPI to power data ingestion, APIs, and real-time features.
- Design RESTful endpoints, schema validation, and background tasks for high-throughput event processing.
- Collaborate with product and data teams to translate requirements into robust, testable services.
- Write unit and integration tests, monitor performance, and iterate on bottlenecks.
- Containerize services, participate in deployments, and improve CI/CD pipelines.
- Troubleshoot production issues, triage incidents, and contribute to postmortems.

What we need (mandatory)
- Python
- FastAPI
- 2-5 years

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Django
- AWS
- Docker

Location & work mode
Hybrid: Chennai, 3 days a week in the office.
